title: Host Terms, Section 9 — Choosing the Cancellation Policy a Listing Offers (Listings)
content:
# Section 9 — Choosing the Cancellation Policy a Listing Offers

*Roamhaven host terms for Roamhaven Listings.*

**9.1** The host chooses which cancellation policy the listing offers to new bookings, from the cancellation policies on the menu of the listing's space type.

**9.2** Long-Term is never chosen, because it attaches automatically to long stays under the Stays charter.

**9.3** A Super Strict policy (Super Strict 30 Days or Super Strict 60 Days) can be chosen only when the host account's tier is Professional Host Plus or Enterprise Partner. The tier is read from the host account as Roamhaven's system records it at the time of the change.

**9.4** A host whose tier later falls below those tiers keeps the Super Strict policy on stays already booked, but the listing's setting must be moved to a policy the host may choose before any further booking is accepted.

**9.5** A change of cancellation policy applies to stays booked after the change is saved and never to a stay already booked.

## Who may choose a Super Strict policy

| Host account tier | May choose Super Strict 30 Days or Super Strict 60 Days |
|---|---|
| Professional Host Plus | yes |
| Enterprise Partner | yes |
| Starter Host, Standard Host, Superhost, Professional Host | no |

A Super Strict policy must also appear on the space type's menu.

## Questions the section answers

**A Superhost with an Entire Home asks to switch to Super Strict 60 Days. May the listing offer it?**
No. The policy is on the Entire Home menu, but Superhost is not one of the two tiers allowed to choose a Super Strict policy.

**An Enterprise Partner moves a listing from Strict to Super Strict 30 Days. What happens to a stay booked last week under Strict?**
Nothing. The change applies only to stays booked after it is saved; the earlier stay keeps Strict.

**A Professional Host Plus account falls to Professional Host while its Entire Apartment offers Super Strict 30 Days.**
Stays already booked keep Super Strict 30 Days. The listing's setting must be moved to a policy the host may choose before any further booking is accepted.

**Can a host select Long-Term for a monthly rental?**
No. Long-Term is never chosen; it attaches automatically to long stays under the Stays charter.
